title: Paul McCartney live: Royal Arena, Copenhagen | 2018
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Royal Arena in Copenhagen, Denmark, on 30 November 2018.

It was the 12th show of the Freshen Up Tour, which lasted for 39 dates between September 2018 and July 2019. This concert was seen by 15,143 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).
